title: 🏡 The right price sells homes.
description:
🏡 The right price sells homes. 

Price it too high and it sits. Price it too low and you leave money on the table. The goal is finding the sweet spot by looking at recent comps and what the market is doing right now. Smart pricing attracts more buyers and stronger offers.
